back.en: Polar, universal solvent, high specific heat capacity, high latent heat, cohesion & adhesion
back.bm: Berkutub, pelarut universal, muatan haba tentu tinggi, haba pendam tinggi, daya lekitan & lekatan

back.en: Glucose, fructose, galactose — all reducing sugars
back.bm: Glukosa, fruktosa, galaktosa — semuanya gula penurun

back.en: Starch (plant store), glycogen (animal store), cellulose (cell walls)
back.bm: Kanji (simpanan tumbuhan), glikogen (simpanan haiwan), selulosa (dinding sel)

back.en: Heat with reducing sugar: blue → green → yellow → brick-red precipitate
back.bm: Panaskan dengan gula penurun: biru → hijau → kuning → mendakan merah bata

back.en: Condensation joins molecules, releasing water. Hydrolysis splits them by adding water
back.bm: Kondensasi menggabungkan molekul, membebaskan air. Hidrolisis memecahkannya dengan menambah air

back.en: Chains of amino acids joined by peptide bonds; contain C, H, O, N (S)
back.bm: Rantai asid amino disambung oleh ikatan peptida; mengandungi C, H, O, N (S)

back.en: Cannot be made by the body — must come from food
back.bm: Tidak boleh disintesis badan — mesti diperoleh daripada makanan

back.en: Saturated: no C=C, solid (animal fats). Unsaturated: C=C, liquid (plant oils)
back.bm: Tepu: tiada C=C, pepejal (lemak haiwan). Tak tepu: ada C=C, cecair (minyak tumbuhan)

back.en: Shake with ethanol, add water → cloudy white emulsion
back.bm: Goncang dengan etanol, tambah air → emulsi putih keruh

back.en: DNA: double helix, deoxyribose, A-T C-G. RNA: single strand, ribose, uracil instead of thymine
back.bm: DNA: heliks ganda dua, deoksiribosa, A-T C-G. RNA: satu bebenang, ribosa, urasil menggantikan timina
